correctness.rationale: The classical level-two Cayley-octad model is explicitly stated. A perfect matching gives a totally isotropic 3-space, 105 distinct cases; an affine F2^3 labelling gives a disjoint totally isotropic 3-space, 30 distinct cases; 105+30 exhaust the known product count 135. For each of the exactly 22 partitions of 8, the complete induced permutation on these 135 subspaces has been constructed, and a separate independent enumeration of all orthogonal triples confirms exact equality of the two sets. All row orbit lengths sum to 135. Rationality over a finite field follows from finite étale Galois descent.

value.rationale: The 22-case complete finite-field descent classification answers the natural arithmetic question of which maximal Weil-isotropic genus-three isogeny kernels descend for a given octad Frobenius partition. Its full orbit data determines extension degrees and a finite étale zeta function, and distinguishes rational kernel schemes from rational bitangents in both directions (eight-cycle and three-cycle plus five fixed points). It is a natural full arithmetic classification rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice. While the known 30+105 representation makes the computation possible, it does not state the tabulated arithmetic outcomes.
